name: Honda CBR1000RR
engine: 998 cc liquid-cooled inline four, fuel injected
intro: Honda's liter superbike. Check the fuel pump recall on 2008-2016 bikes and look for crash damage.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Many 2008-2016 CBR1000RRs are in recall 24V864 for a fuel pump that can fail and stall the engine.
A-002.reason: A stall at speed can cause a crash. The repair is free.

E: Check the frame spars, subframe and fairing mounts for scrapes and cracks.

recalls.what: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine.
recalls.fix: Dealer inspects and replaces the fuel pump free.
